datasets.synthetic: Paper-defined mixture experiments; exact table settings require source recovery.
datasets.mnist: One-vs-rest protocol must be checked against the paper/source before execution.

toolbox_implementation_gaps: The paper says sigma and lambda are selected by cross-validation for each theta, but the immutable author implementation and exact fold/scoring protocol are not locked.
The MNIST experiment uses one-vs-rest classes, four-dimensional PCA, and all samples as Gaussian centers; the executable data protocol is not integrated.

claim_policy: Do not label results paper_like until the paper cross-validation protocol and an immutable source/data manifest are available.
